title: Cost
description: USD per hour from OpenCost (AWS list prices): CPU, memory and GPU allocation priced per node.

panels.title: Cost per namespace
panels.description: CPU, memory and GPU allocation cost per namespace, USD per hour.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace) (label_replace(avg by (container, node, namespace, pod) (container_cpu_allocation) * on (node) group_left () avg by (node) (node_cpu_hourly_cost), "type", "cpu", "", "") or label_replace(avg by (container, node, namespace, pod) (container_memory_allocation_bytes) / 1073741824 * on (node) group_left () avg by (node) (node_ram_hourly_cost), "type", "ram", "", "") or label_replace(avg by (container, node, namespace, pod) (container_gpu_allocation) * on (node) group_left () avg by (node) (node_gpu_hourly_cost), "type", "gpu", "", ""))

panels.title: Cost per model
panels.description: Allocation cost of each model server in the models namespace, USD per hour. The model is the pod name without its ReplicaSet and pod suffixes.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (label_replace(label_replace(avg by (container, node, namespace, pod) (container_cpu_allocation{namespace="models"}) * on (node) group_left () avg by (node) (node_cpu_hourly_cost), "type", "cpu", "", "") or label_replace(avg by (container, node, namespace, pod) (container_memory_allocation_bytes{namespace="models"}) / 1073741824 * on (node) group_left () avg by (node) (node_ram_hourly_cost), "type", "ram", "", "") or label_replace(avg by (container, node, namespace, pod) (container_gpu_allocation{namespace="models"}) * on (node) group_left () avg by (node) (node_gpu_hourly_cost), "type", "gpu", "", ""), "model", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"))

panels.title: Cost per GPU type
panels.description: Whole-node cost of GPU and Neuron nodes, per Karpenter node pool (one pool per GPU type), USD per hour.

targets.expr: sum by (nodepool) (avg by (node) (node_total_hourly_cost) * on (node) group_left (nodepool) label_replace(max by (node_name, nodepool) (karpenter_nodes_allocatable{resource_type=~"nvidia.com/gpu|aws.amazon.com/neuron"} > 0), "node", "$1", "node_name", "(.*)"))
